records.source: Three versions of every crop are written, each a 16-bit set of its own: ``merged/`` (colour composite, no outlines), ``mono/`` (``mono_channel`` in grey, no outlines) and ``outlines/`` (the same grey with the outline of every object type of the host cell - the cell itself and every other mask object overlapping it - in its own colour at ``outline_alpha`` opacity). Display ranges: per channel the ``percentiles`` of the pixels of every crop of the figure (``range_source='crops'``). The outline version is also written ``upsample`` times larger (``*_x4``): the grey image Lanczos upsampled with the outlines drawn anti-aliased at that scale. The figure PDFs draw outlines as vector paths (``contours`` in the result).
records.translation: Þrjár útgáfur af hverjum myndskurði eru skrifaðar, hver sem sérstakt 16-bita safn: ``merged/`` (litasamsetning, engar útlínur), ``mono/`` (``mono_channel`` í gráu, engar útlínur) og ``outlines/`` (sama gráa myndin með útlínu hverrar hlutagerðar hýsilfrumunnar - frumunnar sjálfrar og hvers annars grímuhlutar sem skarast við hana - í eigin lit með ``outline_alpha`` ógegnsæi). Hver þeirra geymir ``<subdir>/<group>_<k>.png/.tif`` og ``<montage_name>.png/.tif`` (raðir = myndskurðir, dálkar = hópar, ``gap`` px hvítar hárlínur). ``raw/`` geymir óbreyttan fjölrása myndskurð (öll mynd- og grímuplön, dtype inntaksins). Útlínuútgáfan er einnig skrifuð ``upsample`` sinnum stærri (``*_x4``): gráa myndin uppsköluð með Lanczos og útlínurnar teiknaðar með mýkingu (anti-aliasing) í þeim kvarða. PDF-myndirnar teikna útlínur sem vigurferla (``contours`` í niðurstöðunni).

records.context: Args: png_channels (ndarray): The extracted image region in file order -- red image layer first -- as :func:`spacr.crops.build_png_channels` assembles it. Written without narrowing, so a ``uint16`` extracted image region becomes a 16-bit PNG; a float extracted image region is silently written as 8-bit by cv2. Four or more image data channels raise rather than losing one to an alpha image layer. img_path (str): Where the PNG goes. Its parent folder is stamped with the format sidecar and **must already exist** -- the caller in ``_measure_crop_core`` creates it. If it does not, the stamp fails with a printed warning, ``cv2.imwrite`` returns False, and the call returns normally having written nothing at all. A bare filename with no directory part stamps the current working directory. grid (list): Anything with ``append``; read only when ``plot`` is true, and appended to in place, so the return value is the object that was passed in. ``None`` passes through untouched while ``plot`` is false. plot (bool): Truthiness, not identity, decides. False (the default) leaves ``grid`` completely untouched -- the PNG is still written -- which is why an ordinary run ends with an empty grid. True appends the extracted image region for :func:`img_list_to_grid`: an extracted image region of exactly dtype ``uint16`` is appended as a high-byte narrowed ``uint8`` copy, every other dtype is appended unchanged, and a ``uint8`` extracted image region is appended by reference, so a caller that reuses its buffer mutates what is already in the grid. crop_format (int or None): The image-region format recorded in the folder's marker. None records the current stretched format. Format 4 marks a raw extracted image region. Its grid copy is shown with the old per extracted image region stretch, because the raw values are usually too dim to see. marker (key-value mapping or None): Extra structured-data names for the folder's marker, such as ``mask_mode`` and ``flat_field_sha256``.

records.source: Args: png_channels (ndarray): The crop in file order -- red plane first -- as :func:`spacr.crops.build_png_channels` assembles it. Written without narrowing, so a ``uint16`` crop becomes a 16-bit PNG; a float crop is silently written as 8-bit by cv2. Four or more channels raise rather than losing one to an alpha plane. img_path (str): Where the PNG goes. Its parent folder is stamped with the format sidecar and **must already exist** -- the caller in ``_measure_crop_core`` creates it. If it does not, the stamp fails with a printed warning, ``cv2.imwrite`` returns False, and the call returns normally having written nothing at all. A bare filename with no directory part stamps the current working directory. grid (list): Anything with ``append``; read only when ``plot`` is true, and appended to in place, so the return value is the object that was passed in. ``None`` passes through untouched while ``plot`` is false. plot (bool): Truthiness, not identity, decides. False (the default) leaves ``grid`` completely untouched -- the PNG is still written -- which is why an ordinary run ends with an empty grid. True appends the crop for :func:`img_list_to_grid`: a crop of exactly dtype ``uint16`` is appended as a high-byte narrowed ``uint8`` copy, every other dtype is appended unchanged, and a ``uint8`` crop is appended by reference, so a caller that reuses its buffer mutates what is already in the grid. crop_format (int or None): The crop format recorded in the folder's marker. None records the current stretched format. Format 4 marks a raw crop. Its grid copy is shown with the old per-crop stretch, because the raw values are usually too dim to see. marker (dict or None): Extra keys for the folder's marker, such as ``mask_mode`` and ``flat_field_sha256``.
records.translation: Args: png_channels (ndarray): Myndskurðurinn í skráarröð -- rauða planið fyrst -- eins og :func:`spacr.crops.build_png_channels` setur hann saman. Skrifaður án þrengingar, svo ``uint16`` myndskurður verður 16-bita PNG; fleytitölumyndskurður er skrifaður hljóðlaust sem 8-bita af cv2. Fjórar eða fleiri rásir valda villu frekar en að ein glatist í alfaplan. img_path (str): Hvert PNG-skráin fer. Yfirmappa hennar er stimpluð með sniðfylgiskránni og **verður þegar að vera til** -- kallandinn í ``_measure_crop_core`` býr hana til. Ef hún er ekki til mistekst stimpillinn með prentaðri viðvörun, ``cv2.imwrite`` skilar False, og kallið skilar eðlilega án þess að hafa skrifað nokkuð. Bert skráarheiti án möppuhluta stimplar núverandi vinnumöppu. grid (list): Hvað sem er með ``append``; aðeins lesið þegar ``plot`` er satt, og bætt við það á staðnum, svo skilagildið er hluturinn sem var sendur inn. ``None`` fer óhreyft í gegn meðan ``plot`` er ósatt. plot (bool): Sanngildi, ekki auðkenni, ræður. False (sjálfgefið) lætur ``grid`` alveg ósnert -- PNG-skráin er samt skrifuð -- og þess vegna endar venjuleg keyrsla með tómt net. True bætir myndskurðinum við fyrir :func:`img_list_to_grid`: myndskurði með nákvæmlega dtype ``uint16`` er bætt við sem ``uint8`` afriti þrengdu í efra bæti, hverju öðru dtype er bætt við óbreyttu, og ``uint8`` myndskurði er bætt við sem tilvísun, svo kallandi sem endurnýtir biðminni sitt breytir því sem þegar er í netinu. crop_format (int or None): Snið myndskurðarins sem skráð er í merki möppunnar. None skráir núverandi teygða sniðið. Snið 4 merkir hráan myndskurð. Netafrit hans er sýnt með gömlu teygingunni fyrir hvern myndskurð, því hráu gildin eru yfirleitt of dauf til að sjást. marker (dict or None): Viðbótarlyklar fyrir merki möppunnar, svo sem ``mask_mode`` og ``flat_field_sha256``.

records.translation: Sameina frumu, umfrymi og kjarna í eina röð á hverja frumu.

records.context: Every cell of the ``cell`` table gives one row, in table order. Its cytoplasm (same field and ``object_label``) is joined one to one. Its nuclei are the ``nucleus`` rows whose ``cell_id`` names it: with ``nucleus="largest"`` the nucleus with the largest ``nucleus_area`` supplies the nucleus columns (ties go to the lower label), with ``"mean"`` or ``"median"`` each nucleus column is that statistic over the cell's nuclei. ``Metadata_n_nuclei`` counts them; a cell without a nucleus has 0 and missing (NaN) nucleus columns. Nuclei outside every cell are left out and counted in ``attrs``.
records.label: spacr.sp_stats.per_cell_table#1

records.translation: Hver fruma í ``cell`` töflunni gefur eina röð, í röð töflunnar. Umfrymi hennar (sama sjónsvið og ``object_label``) er tengt einn á móti einum. Kjarnar hennar eru þær ``nucleus`` raðir þar sem ``cell_id`` nefnir hana: með ``nucleus="largest"`` leggur kjarninn með stærsta ``nucleus_area`` til kjarnadálkana (við jafntefli ræður lægra merkið), með ``"mean"`` eða ``"median"`` er hver kjarnadálkur sú tölfræði yfir kjarna frumunnar. ``Metadata_n_nuclei`` telur þá; fruma án kjarna hefur 0 og vantandi (NaN) kjarnadálka. Kjörnum utan allra frumna er sleppt og þeir taldir í ``attrs``.

records.context: Metadata columns come first: ``Metadata_Plate``, ``Metadata_Well``, ``Metadata_Site``, ``Metadata_timeID`` (timelapse only), ``Metadata_cell_id`` and ``Metadata_n_nuclei``, as pycytominer expects them. Then come the ``cell_*``, ``cytoplasm_*`` and ``nucleus_*`` measurements. Absolute positions (centroids, bounding boxes and the distance to the field edge) are kept as ``Location_*``, which says where a cell was rather than what it looked like, so profiling tools that skip CellProfiler's ``Location_*`` skip them too. Identity and provenance columns are dropped.

records.translation: BÁÐAR NÚLLTILGÁTURNAR ENDURTAKA EIGIÐ ÚRTAK GENSINS. Tölfræði gensins er miðgildi miðgilda leiðsögu-RNA þess. Hvor núlltilgáta dregur eitt gildi fyrir hvert leiðsögu-RNA gensins, af sömu stærð og það leiðsögu-RNA, og tekur miðgildi þeirra.

records.context: The calibrated null is the default. Each simulated guide median is drawn from a normal distribution centred on the median of the non-targeting guides. Its variance is ``between + pi / 2 * cell / n``. Here ``n`` is the guide's cell count and ``cell`` is the squared robust standard deviation of the control cells. The ``between`` term is the variance the non-targeting guide medians show beyond cell sampling. Cells of one guide share microplate sample positions, microscope fields of view and clonal patches, so in an optical pooled screening experiment that term is large.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.bootstrap_gene_pvalues#12
records.source: THE CALIBRATED NULL IS THE DEFAULT. Each simulated guide median is drawn from a normal distribution centred on the median of the non-targeting guides. Its variance is ``between + pi / 2 * cell / n``. Here ``n`` is the guide's cell count and ``cell`` is the squared robust standard deviation of the control cells. The ``between`` term is the variance the non-targeting guide medians show beyond cell sampling. Cells of one guide share wells, fields and clonal patches, so in an optical pooled screen that term is large.
records.translation: KVARÐAÐA NÚLLTILGÁTAN ER SJÁLFGEFIN. Hvert hermt miðgildi leiðsögu-RNA er dregið úr normaldreifingu með miðju í miðgildi non-targeting leiðsögu-RNA. Dreifni þess er ``between + pi / 2 * cell / n``. Hér er ``n`` frumufjöldi leiðsögu-RNA og ``cell`` er traust staðalfrávik viðmiðsfrumnanna í öðru veldi. Liðurinn ``between`` er dreifnin sem miðgildi non-targeting leiðsögu-RNA sýna umfram frumuúrtak. Frumur eins leiðsögu-RNA deila brunnum, sjónsviðum og klónablettum, svo í ljósfræðilegri safnskimun er sá liður stór.

records.context: The cell bootstrap ignores the between-guide variance. It draws as many non-targeting cells as each guide has and takes their median, which is the construction of Funk et al. 2022. Its null therefore holds only cell-sampling noise, and its P values are too small. On one plate of the Funk et al. 2022 screening experiment it called 4,053 of 5,049 genes and a third of the non-targeting guides hits. It is kept only to rerun analyses made before spaCR 1.5.1.8.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.bootstrap_gene_pvalues#13
records.source: THE CELL BOOTSTRAP IGNORES THE BETWEEN-GUIDE VARIANCE. It draws as many non-targeting cells as each guide has and takes their median, which is the construction of Funk et al. 2022. Its null therefore holds only cell-sampling noise, and its P values are too small. On one plate of the Funk et al. 2022 screen it called 4,053 of 5,049 genes and a third of the non-targeting guides hits. It is kept only to rerun analyses made before spaCR 1.5.1.8.
records.translation: FRUMU-BOOTSTRAP HUNSAR DREIFNINA MILLI LEIÐSÖGU-RNA. Það dregur jafnmargar non-targeting frumur og hvert leiðsögu-RNA hefur og tekur miðgildi þeirra, sem er aðferð Funk et al. 2022. Núlltilgáta þess inniheldur því aðeins suð frá frumuúrtaki, og P-gildi þess eru of lág. Á einni plötu úr skimun Funk et al. 2022 greindi það 4,053 af 5,049 genum og þriðjung non-targeting leiðsögu-RNA sem frambjóðendur. Því er aðeins haldið til að endurkeyra greiningar sem gerðar voru fyrir spaCR 1.5.1.8.
